title: UISD's San Isidro Elementary Named Among Texas' Top 25 Lone Star Ribbon Schools
excerpt: San Isidro Elementary has been named a 2026 Lone Star Ribbon School by the State of Texas, placing it among just 25 public schools statewide recognized for academic excellence, United ISD announced Nov. 17.
content:
San Isidro Elementary has been named a 2026 Lone Star Ribbon School by the State of Texas, placing it among just 25 public schools across Texas selected for the recognition, United ISD announced Nov. 17.

The district celebrated the historic achievement for the campus during a special press conference, recognizing a distinction that honors outstanding Texas public schools for academic excellence and student achievement, according to the district.

The Lone Star Ribbon Schools program was established by Gov. Greg Abbott in 2025. It recognizes campuses that show exceptional performance in reading and mathematics, excel across student groups and show measurable progress in closing achievement gaps, according to the district. To qualify, a campus must earn an overall A rating, maintain strong ratings across accountability domains and show consistent student success on state assessments, along with meeting requirements on campus stability, enrollment, accountability, safety, testing integrity, civil rights and special education compliance.

San Isidro Elementary, home of the Raptors, has consistently shown its commitment to academic excellence and has earned recognition as a six-time A-rated campus, according to the district.

Principal Adamina Meza said 2026 was an extraordinary year for the campus, noting that San Isidro had the highest attendance rate among all elementary schools in the district and was the top A-rated campus, which paved the path to the Lone Star recognition.

Superintendent Dr. Gerardo Cruz said the campus earned the award because of academic achievement, noting that students scored around 95% on the state assessment. He said the district is very proud of the teachers and campus administration.

The celebration took place in the school's gymnasium, where students, educators, district representatives and special guests gathered to recognize the achievement, according to the district.

Sources: United ISD, Nov. 17, 2026.
